invariants.description: P_l matches the exact first-order response P_tr + (P_l_init - P_tr) exp(-t/tau_cp)
f_cp is the static sigmoid of P_l

bc_sweep.rationale: pulmonary venous pressure 0-22 mmHg (hypovolaemia to congestion); intrathoracic/muscle pressure -11 to +11 mmHg (deep inspiration to Valsalva); k_l spans both candidate slopes (1.43 mmHg Simulink, 11.76 mmHg supplement table); other constants x0.5-x2.
